European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen was expected to tell EU leaders on Thursday that Brussels is looking at ways to protect the two sectors, the people said on condition of anonymity, with safeguards being the most effective tools currently available to the EU because they can be applied quickly and broadly. Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič struck a deal with Beijing last week that would cap annual imports of Chinese hybrid cars at 350,000 units next year — less than half of expected deliveries this year. European governments have called for further sectors to be protected from surging Chinese imports, as the bilateral trade deficit continues to grow. China overtook Germany as the world’s largest machine-tool exporter in 2025. Chinese exports rose 13% to €8.6 billion, while German exports fell 10% to €7 billion, according to Germany’s VDW machine-tool builders’ association. stories.title: Georgia's surrogacy industry is booming, but at what cost?
stories.summary: Georgia became a hub for surrogate pregnancies after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. DW spoke with parents, and those who wanted to become parents, about the hidden costs of a booming industry.

But surrogacy is illegal in Germany, and people whose children are born through surrogacy must pursue the legal recognition of their parenthood in German courts. Olga is a German citizen but was born and raised in Russia . That's why the couple wanted to learn more about the surrogacy market in Russia. But foreign customers have been banned from signing Russian surrogacy contracts since 2022. After Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine , many international agencies that liaise between surrogates and intended parents moved to Georgia . So, Olga and Daniel traveled there. stories.title: UK students call for school uniforms to be banned in pornography
stories.summary: Short skirts, knee-high socks, white blouses: Girls' school uniform items are widely used as costumes in pornographic videos. As students experience harassment, a group wants to change that.
stories.article_text_excerpt: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5NniG A group of teenage girls in the UK is calling for a ban on selling school uniforms in sex shops Image: Ben Birchall/PA Wire/empics/picture alliance Advertisement Aylin and Mae, both age 15, are members of their school's Little Feminist Book Club in Bicester, Oxfordshire, England. During a group discussion, the club learned that teenagers at other schools were trying to have the sale of school uniforms banned in sex shops . Schoolgirl costumes are also widely used in pornographic videos. "All of us unanimously agreed. We wanted to take it a step further; we wanted to ban school uniform from all pornography," Aylin told DW. As a result, they started a petition to raise awareness of the issue. Many of their fellow students, as the petition states, have already had unpleasant experiences while wearing their uniforms. Some reported being harassed as early as the age of 11. Many of these experiences had left them feeling frightened, ashamed and insecure. "I don't wear my school uniform outside of school," said Mae. "I don't like wearing it out."
